hero.headlineStart: The formulation problems that quietly cost you
hero.lead: We help paint and coating manufacturers develop better formulations, fix failing ones, and turn lab work into production your team can repeat.
hero.ndaNote: Every engagement runs under NDA. Your formulations and process data stay yours.

capabilities.heading: Deep technical help across the whole production line.
capabilities.intro: From a single failing batch to a new plant built from nothing — we work at the level of chemistry, process and quality control, not slogans.

sectors.heading: Manufacturers across five coating markets.
sectors.intro: Each market carries its own chemistry, finish and failure modes. Choose the one that's yours.

approach.heading: A measured path from problem to repeatable production.
approach.intro: Nothing scales until it has been proven on the bench. Every stage produces documentation your team keeps.

cases.heading: Real engagements, client details withheld.
cases.intro: We work under confidentiality, so these are described without naming the manufacturer. The numbers are not.

confidentiality.heading: Your formulations never leave the room.
confidentiality.intro: In this industry, your formulation is the business. We start every engagement with an NDA, and any recipe, process or supplier relationship we touch remains entirely yours.
confidentiality.secondParagraph: It is also why we do not publish client names or logos. You are judging us on the depth of the work — not on whose badge we can display.

insights.heading: Notes from the lab bench.
insights.intro: Practical technical writing — the kind that shows expertise directly and needs no client's permission to publish.

contact.heading: Tell us what's not working.
contact.intro: Describe the problem or the plant you have in mind. You'll hear back from the consultant directly — not a sales desk.

about.heading: Led by a working paint technologist.
about.role: Principal Consultant · Paint, Coating & Resin Technology
about.leadBio: Placeholder bio: three decades formulating and troubleshooting coatings across decorative, industrial and construction-chemical lines, and commissioning manufacturing plants from an empty floor to running production.
about.secondBio: The practice stays deliberately small and senior. When you engage Calibre, you work directly with the person doing the chemistry — not an account layer. Real names, credentials and history go here once the client is ready to share them.
